Name: Pollen Sprites
Author: EscaMMC
TagLine: Pollen Sprites adds a new type of non-hostile monster. They appear on windy days in spring, float around players harmlessly, and sometimes drop random seeds when defeated.
Description:
**Pollen Sprites** adds a new type of non-hostile monster. They appear on windy days, float around players harmlessly, and sometimes drop random seeds when defeated. You'll find them around the farm and various parts of the wilderness. You can also enable options to give yourself "allergy" effects or change which seeds they drop.

Created for the Spring 2020 event on the [Stardew Valley Discord server](https://discord.gg/stardewvalley).

- - - - -
### Installation
- - - - -
1. Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).
2. Install the latest version of [Content Patcher](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher).
3. Install the latest version of [Farm Type Manager](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/598755-farm-type-manager-ftm).
4. Download Pollen Sprites from the Download tab above, the [GitHub Releases page](https://github.com/Esca-MMC/PollenSprites/releases), or [Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6149).
5. Unzip Pollen Sprites into your __Stardew Valley\Mods__ folder.

- - - - -
### Options
- - - - -
Pollen Sprites have some optional "allergy" effects and customizable seed drop chances. To edit these options:

1. **Run the game** using SMAPI. This will generate the mod's config.json file in the __Stardew Valley\Mods\PollenSprites\PollenSprites__ folder.
2. **Exit the game** and open the config.json file with any text editing program.


This mod also supports [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/771692-generic-mod-config-menu) (GMCM). Users with that mod will be able to change config.json settings from Stardew's main menu.

For specific information about each option, highlight them in GMCM or refer to the [GitHub readme](https://github.com/Esca-MMC/PollenSprites#options).

- - - - -
### Customization
- - - - -
The number of pollen sprites spawned, their locations, and other settings can be changed by editing the __Stardew Valley\Mods\PollenSprites\[FTM] PollenSprites\content.json__ file.

Farm Type Manager also includes a visual editor for this file. To use it:

1. Download Farm Type Manager's Config Editor from [GitHub](https://github.com/Esca-MMC/FarmTypeManager/blob/master/FarmTypeManager/ConfigEditor.html) or [Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231?tab=files).
2. Open it with any web browser.
3. Click the "Load" button and select the __Stardew Valley\Mods\PollenSprites\[FTM] PollenSprites\content.json__ file.
4. Click the "Monsters" tab.
5. Edit any of the available settings.
6. Click the "Save" button and overwrite the __Stardew Valley\Mods\PollenSprites\[FTM] PollenSprites\content.json__ file.
